name: It's a Pink Area
description: Discover new and existing works by New York-based artists Marc Kokopeli and Sydney Schrader in the beautiful setting of Casa São Roque.
longDescription:
"It's a Pink Area" is an art exhibition showcasing new and existing works by New York-based artists Marc Kokopeli and Sydney Schrader. The exhibition presents a collection of pieces that explore contemporary themes through their distinct artistic practices. This presentation offers an opportunity to engage with the latest developments in their respective oeuvres within a European context.

Visitors to Casa São Roque can expect to view a curated selection of artworks displayed within the historic building. The exhibition is open for a week, allowing for multiple opportunities to visit. The setting of Casa São Roque provides a unique backdrop for the contemporary art on display, fostering an atmosphere of contemplation and engagement with the works.

The exhibition runs from April 30th to May 6th, 2026. For specific opening hours and ticket information, please check the Casa São Roque website. Casa São Roque is located in Porto and can be reached by public transport; further details on accessibility and transport links will be available on the venue's website.
